CBScript, by SethBling (https://github.com/SethBling/cbscript), is bundled inside this mod's jar as tools/cbscript.zip,
through Moddy's fork, jivinstev/moddy-cbscript. Moddy uses it to compile the datapacks behind an item's or a creature's
powers.

CBScript carries no open-source licence. It is used in Moddy, and modified for it, with its author's permission
(given verbally, November 2026). The original code remains the copyright of its author. Moddy's own changes in the fork
are licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, like the rest of Moddy.

The zip also carries PLY (Python Lex-Yacc) 3.11 by David M. Beazley (Dabeaz LLC), under the BSD 3-Clause licence;
its copyright notice and licence text are kept at the top of each of its files (ply/*.py), as that licence requires.
